headline: Google Chrome Update to End Support for Popular Ad Blockers
summary: Google is removing the last workarounds for Manifest V2 extensions, effectively disabling legacy ad blockers like the original uBlock Origin.
details: Google Chrome's upcoming update will mark the end of support for popular ad blockers by removing the final workarounds for Manifest V2 extensions.

A recent Chromium commit has disabled the "kExtensionManifestV2Disabled" flag, which was previously used to maintain compatibility with older ad-blocking extensions such as the original uBlock Origin.
This change signifies Google's continued push towards Manifest V3, which imposes stricter limitations on how extensions can function, particularly impacting ad-blocking capabilities.
While newer ad blockers built on Manifest V3 are expected to continue working, users relying on older, more powerful extensions will likely need to find alternatives or switch browsers.
